heroSection.description: A Java-focused Full-Stack Engineer specializing in high-performance backends and clean, maintainable frontends. I build software that solves real problems without the fluff.

about.endingLine: Engineered for long-term stability and human readability under change.

segments.title: How I Think
segments.label: Clarity
segments.text: I focus on writing code that is easy to understand and hard to break. I value clear logic and correctness over clever shortcuts, so the software I build remains reliable as it grows.

segments.title: How I Build
segments.label: Foundations
segments.text: I work primarily with Java and Spring, learning how backend systems are structured. I pay attention to API design, data flow, and concurrency basics to build predictable services.

segments.title: How I Learn
segments.label: Iteration
segments.text: I learn by implementing concepts end-to-end. Instead of memorizing patterns, I build small projects, experiment with edge cases, and refine my understanding through iteration.

segments.title: Where I’m Going
segments.label: Growth
segments.text: I am currently strengthening my fundamentals in data structures, system design, and distributed systems to prepare for building larger and more complex applications.

projects.title: Pokeverse
projects.tagline: A real-time multiplayer game platform built to host multiple interactive games under a shared infrastructure.
projects.description: Pokeverse is a real-time multiplayer game platform built to host multiple interactive games under a shared infrastructure. It features modular, pluggable game modules such as a Pokémon Quiz, utilizing WebSocket and STOMP protocols to power real-time game rooms, live matchmaking, events, and instant communication.
highlights: Designed a modular real-time game platform supporting multiple game types.
Implemented Pokémon Quiz as a pluggable game module (single-player & multiplayer).
Built real-time rooms, matchmaking, live events, and chat using WebSocket + STOMP.
Centralized OAuth2 authentication with JWT access and refresh tokens.

projects.title: Hermes
projects.tagline: A real-time web chat application enabling private messaging, group chats, and image sharing.
projects.description: A real-time web chat application enabling private messaging, group chats, and image sharing using WebSocket and REST APIs. Features JWT-based stateless authentication alongside stateful user mechanics like live online/offline presence tracking and responsive group channel management.
highlights: Implemented real-time 1:1 and group chat using WebSocket + STOMP.
JWT-based stateless authentication with Spring Security.
Supports image sharing, online/offline presence, and group management.

projects.title: Calculate
projects.tagline: A modular, stack-based scientific calculator that parses and evaluates complex expressions.
projects.description: A modular, stack-based scientific calculator that parses expressions, converts them to postfix notation, and evaluates results using classic compiler techniques. Supports implicit multiplication, explicit domain validation, and handles over 50 scientific functions and mathematical constants seamlessly.
highlights: Implemented expression parsing using tokenization and the shunting-yard algorithm.
Supports implicit multiplication and 50+ scientific functions and constants.
Evaluates expressions via stack-based postfix (RPN) execution with domain validation.
